meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 它接管 git 操作：把改动拆成多个原子提交，提交前先检测仓库的提交风格和语言；还能改写历史（rebase、squash）和查历史（blame、bisect、log -S）。
howto.when: 当你提到 “commit”、“rebase”、“squash” 等关键词，或要查某次改动是谁、何时加进来时触发；原文写明任何 git 操作都必须用它。

say.text: 把这些改动提交，拆成多个原子 commit
say.note: 先检测仓库风格，再分批提交

say.text: 帮我把这几个 commit squash 到一起
say.note: 进入 rebase 模式改写历史

say.text: 查一下这行代码是谁写的、什么时候加的
say.note: 走历史检索，用 blame 或 bisect

howto.what_en: It takes over git work: splits changes into multiple atomic commits, first detecting the repo's commit style and language; it also rewrites history (rebase, squash) and searches history (blame, bisect, log -S).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "commit", "rebase", "squash" and similar keywords, or ask who wrote a change or when it was added; the doc states it must be used for any git operation.

say_en.text: Commit these changes as multiple atomic commits
say_en.note: detects repo style, then splits them

say_en.text: Squash these commits together for me
say_en.note: enters rebase mode to rewrite history

say_en.text: Find who wrote this line and when it was added
say_en.note: runs history search via blame or bisect
